error_message: CRITICAL: Company-wide login failure – 100% of authentication requests rejected across all regions. Token-signing key suspected corrupted after cert rotation.
CRITICAL: Primary PostgreSQL node unresponsive. Replication lag exceeded 9000 s. Automatic failover did not trigger. All production writes blocked.
CRITICAL: Payment transactions failing – processor returning HTTP 500 for all charge and refund requests. Revenue loss estimated at $12 000/min. Stripe webhooks timing out.
CRITICAL: Security breach suspected – 47 000 failed login attempts in 10 minutes from 312 distinct IPs. Possible credential-stuffing attack in progress.
CRITICAL: Core switch SW-03 unreachable. Inter-VLAN routing between data-centre pods A and B has failed. Approximately 60 % of internal services unavailable.
CRITICAL: Outbound email delivery completely stopped. SMTP relay cluster returning connection refused. All transactional and alert emails queued but undelivered.
HIGH: JavaScript bundle fails to load on Safari 17.x – white screen on initial page load. Affects ~18 % of active user base. Consistently reproduced on macOS Sonoma.
HIGH: Slow database queries degrading API response times. Nightly reporting job running for 4 h 22 min against 45-min SLA. Missing index on orders_archive suspected.
HIGH: Duplicate charge records appearing for recurring transactions. Idempotency key collision rate at 0.8 %. Finance flagged 34 affected customer accounts.
HIGH: Wi-Fi access point cluster in London office unresponsive after firmware push. ~200 employees unable to connect. Ethernet fallback available but limited.
MEDIUM: Password reset emails delayed 18–25 minutes. SMTP relay queue depth at 94 %. No authentication failures reported but user complaints rising.
MEDIUM: Intermittent packet loss (3–7 %) on uplink between office-lon-02 and cloud egress router. Degrading video-conferencing quality; no full service outage.
MEDIUM: Session timeout modal fires after 2 minutes of inactivity instead of the configured 30 minutes. Affects all authenticated users since deploy v4.11.2.
MEDIUM: Email delivery delay of 15–40 minutes observed for password-reset and MFA notification emails. Bulk marketing emails unaffected. Root cause under investigation.
MEDIUM: Disk utilisation on replica node db-replica-02 reached 78 %. Current growth rate projects threshold breach within 36 hours without intervention.
MEDIUM: Currency symbol rendered incorrectly on PDF invoices for EU customers (€ displays as â‚¬). Amounts and payment records are correct; cosmetic impact only.
LOW: MFA setup wizard loses progress when user navigates back using the browser back button. No data loss occurs; workaround is to restart the flow.
LOW: Dark-mode toggle resets to light mode on every page navigation. User preference not persisted to local storage correctly. Purely cosmetic issue.
LOW: DNS TTL for staging.internal incorrectly set to 86 400 s instead of 300 s. Causes stale DNS resolution after environment redeployments. No production impact.
LOW: Email footer logo missing in Outlook desktop client for refund confirmation emails. Renders correctly in all web and mobile clients. No functional impact.
